text.offer: You've done this town a lot of good. Now hear me: Meridian is split three ways. Duke Akardius holds Tos, Princess Kateriina holds Barloque, and Jonas D'Accor's rebels hide out near Jasper. Whatever is raising the dead, it's one of them - or all of them - who'll have to stop it. Go and hear each of them out, then come back and tell me who you'd stand with.
text.progress: The Duke is in Tos, the Princess in Barloque, and Jonas near Jasper.
text.complete: Then you've seen them all. Choose well - the side you pick will decide where you're welcome, and who calls you enemy.

steps.objective: Hear out Duke Akardius in Tos
Hear out Princess Kateriina in Barloque
Hear out Jonas D'Accor near Jasper
